title: Nakamachi Street — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: Nakamachi merchant houses flourished in the Edo period along the road to Zenkoji.
facts.excerpt: flourished in the Edo period (1603–1868) along the Zenkoji Temple road.

facts.fact: Traditional kura storehouses with black-and-white plaster namako walls helped protect against fires in the late Edo and Meiji periods.
facts.excerpt: with white and black namako walls made of plaster

facts.fact: The present street combines craft shops, a Matsumoto Mingei furniture showroom, cafés, restaurants and wells.
facts.excerpt: craft shops, fashionable cafes, and restaurants.

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
